cohort: The study participants were 130 neonates diagnosed with congenital anomalies in Albatool teaching hospital in Baquba city, Diyala province.
finding: The study found that nervous system anomalies were the most common type of congenital malformation, with higher incidence linked to male sex, consanguineous marriage, and lack of periconceptional folic acid use.
mod_finding: A high percentage (60%) of congenital anomalies was recorded among neonates born by caesarean section.
birth_weight: The study included neonates, of whom 53.84% had low birth weight.
gest_age: The study included neonates, of whom 57% were premature.
